title: Conflicting reports about a fictional port
question: What can be established about Northport reopening, and what remains disputed?

events.title: Northport operator announces full reopening
events.summary: The operator says all cargo terminals reopened at 08:00 UTC on 6 September. No supporting throughput data is attached.

events.title: Northport cargo terminals are not fully reopened
events.summary: The harbour authority says only berth 1 accepts cargo; berths 2 to 5 remain closed pending inspection. This directly disputes the operator's full-reopening announcement.

events.title: Northport approach sensor counts two arrivals
events.summary: Two vessel transits were detected in the approach channel from 08:00 to 10:00 UTC. The sensor cannot establish which berth was used or whether cargo was discharged.

reference_facts: The operator claims full reopening; the authority explicitly limits access to berth 1.
Two detected arrivals establish neither terminal capacity nor cargo discharge.
required_caveats: Distinguish vessel movements from terminal operation.
forbidden_inferences: Full reopening is confirmed by the vessel count.
The sensor proves the authority is wrong.
